name: elysium-mainnet-gloak
_records: What deploy-v2-factory.mjs and deploy-partner.mjs wrote on mainnet: the factory, hook and token deployer (its door belongs to the owner wallet), and the launch vault, router, batch rounds and private bids that make GLOAK's private zone.
admin: FILL IN: the owner wallet. GLOAK's admin, and the only key that can use the door (once).

launch._supply: 500,000 GLOAK, no team share: 294,000 for sale, 206,000 to pair with HYPE in the pool. The reserve must be at least the sale × the pool's share (205,800 at 70%). A sold-out sale uses about 202,700 of it at any price, so about 3,300 is burned. An undersold sale burns the unsold part and the unused reserve.
launch._lpBps: 70% of the raise (after the 1.5% launch fee) into the pool, locked forever; 30% to Cloak's treasury for buybacks. Deeper than the usual 50% because GLOAK can't be traded anywhere else. Decided (docs/GLOAK.md).
launch._prices: 0.0002 to 0.01 HYPE per GLOAK in 256 levels (steps of about 0.0000384 HYPE). Sold out at the lowest price: 58.8 HYPE raised, about 40.5 HYPE in the pool, all GLOAK worth about 100 HYPE. At the top: 2,940 HYPE raised, about 2,027 HYPE in the pool, all GLOAK worth about 5,000 HYPE. Decided Nov 11.
launch.commitEnd: FILL IN: when bidding closes, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00Z. The owner wallet's door call must land before it.
launch._reveal: The keeper opens every sealed bid with the drand time-lock key just after bidding closes; 30 minutes is plenty. Trading starts when it ends and the launch settles.
launch._minRaise: None: GLOAK opens its pool whatever it raises (decided Nov 11). Its door works once, so a failed launch couldn't be redone.
